products.overview: High-speed, deep-cooled SWIR imaging for demanding scientific experiments and industrial applications.
features: Extended 900–2500 nm SWIR Sensitivity: ZephIR™ 2.5e covers 900 to 2500 nm, providing access to an extended SWIR wavelength range suitable for applications requiring spectral information beyond conventional shorter-wave infrared ranges.
T2SL Focal Plane Array: The camera uses a T2SL FPA with 640 × 512 pixels and 15 µm pixel size, providing a scientific imaging platform for extended-SWIR applications.
Deep TEC Cooling to −80 °C: At 20 °C ambient, ZephIR™ 2.5e can reach −80 °C using TEC + forced-air cooling, helping reduce unwanted detector noise and support improved signal acquisition.
High-Speed Full-Frame Imaging: ZephIR™ 2.5e provides a frame rate of 240 fps, supporting high-speed SWIR imaging where temporal resolution is important.

Up to 4000 fps ROI Acquisition: When imaging only a selected region of interest, the camera can achieve ROI frame rates up to 4000 fps — useful for experiments and industrial processes where a selected region must be monitored at high temporal resolution.
High Quantum Efficiency: The camera has a specified peak quantum efficiency greater than 70%.
High Operability: Typical detector operability is specified at greater than 99%.

Flexible Gain Settings: The camera provides high, medium and low gain settings — High: 45 e−/ADU, 45 e− typical readout noise, 28 ke− typical full well; Medium: 75 e−/ADU, 75 e− typical readout noise, 110 ke− typical full well; Low: 300 e−/ADU, 300 e− typical readout noise, 1400 ke− typical full well.
Multiple Readout Modes: Supports CDS ITR, CDS IWR, and IMRO IWR readout modes.
Multiple Data Formats: Image data can be provided in 16-bit HDF5, FITS, and TIFF formats, providing flexibility for scientific analysis and integration with existing data workflows.

applications: Very high-speed ROI imaging: Up to 4000 fps.

Scientific imaging: T2SL FPA — combining the T2SL FPA, deep TEC cooling, 900–2500 nm spectral sensitivity, 14-bit digitization, multiple gain settings, flexible integration times, scientific data formats, and C++/Python SDK support for researchers developing custom SWIR imaging and spectroscopy systems.
Custom system development: C++ / Python SDK.
Industrial integration: USB 3.0 / CameraLink™ — supporting industrial imaging systems that need high acquisition speed, reliable integration, and extended infrared sensitivity.

faqs.question: What is ZephIR™ 2.5e?
faqs.answer: ZephIR™ 2.5e is a deep-cooled SWIR camera from Photon etc. designed for infrared imaging from 900 to 2500 nm.

faqs.question: Does ZephIR™ 2.5e support external triggering?

faqs.question: Can ZephIR™ 2.5e be integrated into custom software?

faqs.question: What image formats are supported?

longForm.heroHook: Deep-Cooled SWIR Imaging from 900 to 2500 nm
longForm.heroLead: High-speed, deep-cooled SWIR imaging for demanding scientific experiments and industrial applications. Photon etc. ZephIR™ 2.5e is a deep-cooled short-wave infrared (SWIR) camera sensitive from 900 to 2500 nm. Its T2SL focal plane array, deep thermoelectric cooling and low-noise operation are designed to help acquire weak infrared signals with improved signal quality. The camera uses a 640 × 512 pixel sensor with 15 µm pixels and provides frame rates up to 240 fps, with ROI frame rates up to 4000 fps. ZephIR™ 2.5e uses TEC + forced-air cooling and can reach a cooling temperature of −80 °C at 20 °C ambient, without requiring water cooling or liquid-nitrogen refrigeration. For system integration, the camera supports USB 3.0 and CameraLink™, external trigger input/output, and Photon etc.'s PHySpec™ control and analysis software. Developers can also use the supplied C++ and Python SDK.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: ZephIR™ 2.5e combines extended SWIR sensitivity with deep thermoelectric cooling and high-speed acquisition.
body: Deep-cooled SWIR camera designed for high-sensitivity infrared imaging from 900–2500 nm.
Features a T2SL (Type-II Superlattice) focal plane array with 640 × 512 pixel resolution and 15 µm pixel size.
Equipped with deep thermoelectric cooling (TEC) that enables detector temperatures as low as −80 °C at 20 °C ambient.
Deep cooling reduces detector noise, improving signal quality and image sensitivity for demanding infrared applications.
Extended spectral range up to 2500 nm enables broader SWIR imaging and enhanced infrared detection capabilities.
Delivers 240 fps full-frame imaging for fast data acquisition.
Supports ROI frame rates up to 4000 fps for high-speed imaging of dynamic events.
Ideal for scientific research, industrial inspection, spectroscopy, and other applications requiring both high infrared sensitivity and rapid image acquisition.

sections.title: Why Deep-Cooled SWIR Imaging?
body: Infrared detectors generate unwanted signals that can interfere with the measurement of weak infrared features. ZephIR™ 2.5e uses deep thermoelectric cooling to reduce unwanted detector noise.

At 20 °C ambient, the camera can reach a cooling temperature of −80 °C using TEC + forced-air cooling. According to Photon etc., this deep cooling allows the camera to acquire more signal and minimize unwanted noise for a given imaging application.

ZephIR™ 2.5e uses thermoelectric cooling rather than liquid-nitrogen cooling. The supplied manufacturer information highlights that the system does not require water cooling, does not require a liquid-nitrogen cooling unit, and does not depend on mechanical Stirling coolers — avoiding the limited lifetime associated with mechanical Stirling coolers. This can simplify integration into laboratory and industrial imaging systems.

sections.title: Software, SDK and System Integration
sections.description: ZephIR™ 2.5e provides multiple interfaces and external controls for integration into larger imaging systems, and can be operated using Photon etc.'s PHySpec™ software or integrated into custom systems via SDK.
